[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra II.5 (Sādhanapāda) — Anityāśuciduḥkhānātmasu nityaśucisukhātmakhyātiravidyā | Pages 397-406]

 śarīram aśuci, tathāpi tatra śucikhyātau kiṃ pramāṇam ity ākāṅkāyām āha-- aśucau
śucikhyātir dṛśyata iti / Navīnaśaśāṅkavad iyaṃ kanyā kamanīyā madhuno'mṛtasya vāvayavair
aṃśair nirmiteva dṛśyate / Hāvaḥ-- śṛṅgārajā līlā, kasya strīkāyasya nikṛṣṭasya kena
candrakalādinātinirmalenābhisaṃbandhaḥ sādharmyam ? Nāsty eva vivakṣitasādharmyam ity arthaḥ
/ Upasaṃharati-- bhavatīti / Eteneti bhāṣye / Etenāśucau śucikhyāter vyākhyānenāpuṇye
